title: Benefits Admin Handoff
task_prompt:
## task_008: Downstream Candidate -- Benefits Admin Handoff

Using my usual benefits default, draft a message to my workplace benefits contact checking on my HealthFirst open enrollment — I heard the dependent paperwork is still incomplete. I'm enrolled in BlueCross BlueShield PPO Select Plus, Delta Dental Premium Plan, and VSP Vision Care Standard Option, with my spouse Michael Chen as a dependent. Pull the exact plan details and current status you keep on file for me, grounded in my current insurance records based on the files you normally check. Ask for a complete dependent coverage summary so I have the full enrollment picture, and note where this sits alongside my other pending paperwork. Keep it professional yet conversational, ready to send.
answer:
Subject: HealthFirst open enrollment and dependent coverage paperwork

Hi [Benefits Contact],

I’m reviewing my 2026 open-enrollment information and wanted to confirm the status of my dependent coverage paperwork with HealthFirst. I understand that some of the dependent documentation may still be incomplete—could you please let me know exactly what remains outstanding, if anything, and what I need to submit?

For reference, my current benefits records show:
- Medical: BlueCross BlueShield PPO Select Plus — coverage period January 1–December 31, 2026
- Dental: Delta Dental Premium Plan — coverage period January 1–December 31, 2026
- Vision: VSP Vision Care Standard Option — coverage period January 1–December 31, 2026
- Dependent: my spouse, Michael Chen, listed with active coverage beginning January 1, 2026

Could you also send me a complete summary of Michael’s dependent coverage—including which plans he is enrolled in, the effective date, and whether any dependent verification or other documentation is still required? It would be helpful to know where this item stands relative to my other pending paperwork and whether there are any deadlines or next steps I should be aware of.

Thank you for your help,
Alice
